title: Log
supportKofi: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
queued_one: Added {{count}} chapter of {{title}} to its download
queued_other: Added {{count}} chapters of {{title}} to its download
languageFallbackAll: language "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading all of them instead
languageFallbackNone: language "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading no filter instead
languageFallbackValue: language "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading "{{fallback}}" instead
groupFallbackAll: scanlation group "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading all of them instead
groupFallbackNone: scanlation group "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading no filter instead
groupFallbackValue: scanlation group "{{value}}" isn't in this series, loading "{{fallback}}" instead
bundleEmpty: packing bundle: no chapter could be downloaded
cancelling: Cancelling: chapters already downloading will finish, no new ones start
exists: skipping {{name}}: it's already in the folder
waiting: waiting for {{label}}: another copy of the app is downloading {{name}}
skipping: skipping {{label}}: every page is excluded by --skip-pages
removedSame: moved {{name}} to the Recycle Bin: same file as {{kept}}
removedNumber: moved {{name}} to the Recycle Bin: chapter {{number}} is already {{kept}}
removeFailed: couldn't move the duplicate {{name}} to the Recycle Bin: {{reason}}
deleting_one: deleting series {{title}}: {{count}} file ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin
deleting_other: deleting series {{title}}: {{count}} files ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin
deleteMoved: moved {{done}} of {{total}} to the Recycle Bin
deleteFileFailed: couldn't move {{name}} to the Recycle Bin: {{reason}}
deleteIncomplete_one: {{count}} file of the series couldn't be moved and is still there
deleteIncomplete_other: {{count}} files of the series couldn't be moved and are still there
removed_one: moved {{count}} duplicate file ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin
removed_other: moved {{count}} duplicate files ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin
correlating_one: looking for duplicates among {{count}} file in the folder
correlating_other: looking for duplicates among {{count}} files in the folder
compared: looking for duplicates: compared {{done}} of {{total}} files that share a size
